venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Tuesday 8/25 (MOD: MKZ/JK)** Hit target exactly at $2,153. Last Bingo Tuesday of August with Red Bull — the Red Bull crew joined for Bingo with fun gifts to end the month, and lots of familiar faces in the crowd. Meal Deal drew some regulars. Jess's last day — sad but grateful. Down a barback, so the opening bartender knocked out batches and MOD supported the bar. Quiet day for the kitchen. 86 soap, low dust. Visit from Hennessy rep Jay was the favorite moment. No incidents.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Tuesday 8/25 (MOD: MD/JMS)** Just over target. Steady Tuesday with a smaller-than-usual bingo crowd; first influx at 8:15pm, leveling by 8:45 and staying steady through close. Regulars Thomas and Chris Núñez + friends closed out the night, plus out-of-town industry guests who promised to return. John Michael held down the kitchen. 86 Diet Coke, low Montenegro. Comps 2.4% (manager, employee, bingo credit, resident, industry, F&F). No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Tuesday 8/25 (AM: Carey, Maggie S & Chef Lucas / PM: Magz & Chef Rach)** Beat target ($8,218 vs $7,923) with a waitlist on a Tuesday. AM was slow-steady ($1,196) with deep cleaning of the well and drains plus Saratoga restock and three iced-tea batches. PM ($7,022) ran busy enough that there were no early cuts. Upsell push paying off — Reagan sold a $71 Stranahan's 12yr Old Fashioned and a $20 Nikka Last Word on one ticket. No events. Favorite moment: a NY visitor at Marquee thanking the whole team for the hospitality.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Tuesday 8/25 (MOD: Seth + Steves)** "Relatively ripping Tuesday" over target ($3,952 vs $3,600). Slower start, picked up fast into the second and third turns — quick turnover, pre-dinner drinks, enthusiastic tourists; full capacity around 9:30pm. Industry guest Josiah Fischer (Head Chef, Occidental/Williams & Graham, Denver). Three guests B13'd at the door for menacing staff. Sharp drop at 11:30 — seating stopped due to a team injury (Nick cut his hand). Comps just 1%. Closed out by two local theatre directors and a tarot reading.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Tuesday 8/25 (MOD: Joe + Vic)** Sleepy Tuesday well under target ($3,100 vs $4,957). Started with a humble 13 covers and a very slow couple of hours; room filled around 9pm with a nice push 9–10:30pm before dying back down. A few walk-ins in the last hour made for a smooth close. Chill night in the kitchen. Comps $55 (Tom from Thunderbolt, Angel, regular, DNL). Favorite moment: Bailey playing Dolly Parton. No incidents; no-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.weather: Amazing, lovely evening on the cooler side
venues.narrative: **DC — Tuesday 8/25 (MOD: Marcus)** Just shy of target ($3,042 vs $3,154). Restaurant Week has the alley riding the Michelin coattails; slower start then steady 7–10pm. Gorgeous weather let them seat the garden, with Chaz double-dutying host and garden service. Fatema Issa (Vera Cocina, Ivy City) celebrated her birthday; first-timer Quinlan from NC got the full D&C treatment at Bar 1. 83 guests (67 walk-in / 16 resos). Garbage disposal still awaiting service tech. Coaching note: keep resetting the room to zero during lulls.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Sunny start, big rainstorm ~4:30pm, then on-and-off showers
venues.narrative: **MG — Tuesday 8/25 (AM: Victoria & Shannon / PM: Justin & Drew)** Well under target ($2,270 vs $5,000) — rainstorms killed street traffic. Very chill morning (Sierra solo-served, $521); evening ($1,606) started with one reservation and ran mostly hotel guests, with a quick 7:30 pop for the skeleton crew and no new guests after 10. Sun Club $143 — storm pushed everyone out at 4:30, but Aimee got storm-close training. Notable: usually Monday OR Tuesday is busy — not this week. Drew R&D'd some new dishes during the slowness. (Report date field said 8/24; matched to Tuesday 8/25 by post time.)
